newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Consortia deadline in Brazil CVRD sale extended.
newsitem.headline: Consortia deadline in Brazil CVRD sale extended.

text.p: The deadline by which consortia had to register with the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange in order to take part in the privatization auction of Brazilian state mining giant CVRD has been extended, a bourse spokeswoman said.

The deadline has been moved to 1830 local time/2130 GMT from 1600 local time/1900 GMT previously for consortia to present a list of their members and financial guarantees for three billion reais ($2.83 billion) among other documents, the spokeswoman said.
Two consortia are expected to register for the April 29 auction of a 40-45-percent voting stake in CVRD at a base price of 3 billion reais ($2.83 billion).

One consortium is being led by Brazilian metal, cement and pulp group Votorantim and South Africa's Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd and the other one is headed by Brazil's largest steelmaker CSN.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
